messages:
maya: quick thread to scope the inter-team quota transfer pilot for Dedicated pools. customer wants predictable burst + ability to move credits between org teams during planned events. can we draft roadmap items?
kevin: high level tradeoffs: (1) guarantee window vs best-effort burst, (2) synchronous vs async transfers, (3) billing model (prepaid credits vs invoiced usage). each affects runtime and billing.
liu: SRE note: any transfer mechanism must not allow instantaneous draining of a pool. we need rate limits + quota floor. also observability hooks per-pool and per-transfer.
rishi: product ask: customers want admin delegation (org admins can transfer), audit trail, and scheduled transfers (e.g., move 300k tokens from infra->marketing at 09:00).
taylor: commercial: pilot customers will sign if we offer a narrow SLA for scheduled bursts (e.g., 4-hour windows with x% attainment). otherwise they want refunds. we should avoid hard refunds in pilot.
maya: propose a 3-phase rollout:
- phase 0 (discovery): spec and legal check, acceptance criteria, sample SLA text
- phase 1 (MVP): async scheduled transfers, ledger entries, holdback floor (configurable default), no cross-customer transfers, transfers expire at period boundary
- phase 2: add realtime transfers, transfer automation rules, and self-serve approvals
kevin: agree. for MVP we implement async scheduled transfers + manual approval toggle. runtime behavior: apply transfer to pool as "soft credit" that is lowest eviction priority and subject to holdback.
liu: eviction ordering: 1) ephemeral burst cache, 2) delegated soft credits (new), 3) reserved owner credits. this preserves owner SLOs. also need cooldown after large transfer to avoid oscillation.
rishi: sample scheduled transfer payload:
```yaml
transfer:
  org: acme
  from: infra
  to: marketing
  amount_tokens: 300000
  effective_time: "2025-05-12T09:00:00Z"
  expiry: 2025-05-12T13:00:00Z
  require_approval: true
```
kevin: add parameters: min_balance (to ensure source can't go below X), max_rate_per_minute, and audit_reason.
taylor: billing ops: MVP billing approach = treat transferred tokens as prepaid internal credits that are consumed from recipient's bucket for the window, reconciliation nightly. no carryover. confirm?
maya: yes for MVP: no carryover, nightly reconciliation job, reconciliation alert if delta > 0.5%.
liu: telemetry minimal set: `transfer.scheduled.count`, `transfer.executed.count`, `transfer.size.histogram`, `pool.preemptions.by_owner_type`, `pool.latency.p95/p99`, `billing.reconcile.error_rate`. set alert when `preemptions.by_owner_type[delegated] > 2x baseline` for 10m.
kevin: QA plan: run chaos test that simulates concurrent transfers + spike traffic on adjacent pools. validate p95 latency and preemption counts. gate = pass chaos + reconciliation success.
rishi: legal/compliance: need audit log retention 3 months for pilot and an admin revoke endpoint.
maya: decision needed from eng by Thu EOD: can we deliver MVP items (ledger + scheduled transfer runner + revoke endpoint + basic UI toggle) in 2 sprints if we limit approvals to manual?
evops: ops-bot: FYI staging cluster has 30% free headroom next 2 weeks for pilot testing. tag @eng-sre for canary.
kevin: engineering estimate: core ledger + transfer runner + revoke API = 2 sprints. admin UI and scheduled job dashboard another sprint. observability + alerts can land in parallel.
liu: default holdback recommendation = 15% of reserved pool, configurable per-pool and per-org. we should make it a soft default.
taylor: commercial asks to negotiate: approval threshold amount (we propose >150k requires admin OK), and whether transfers count against committed usage (we propose yes for pilot).
maya: acceptance criteria for pilot launch:
- scheduled transfers succeed and appear in audit log (manual spot checks)
- no SLO regressions for pools in pilot (p95 latency within 10% of baseline)
- reconciliation job completes with <0.5% discrepancy across 3 consecutive nights
- revoke endpoint works and we test it during chaos run
kevin: out-of-scope for pilot: cross-customer transfers, automatic policy-based rebalancing, carryover credits, invoiced refunds.
rishi: next steps: I'll write the product PRD and SLA appendix, include sample API + UI mockups.
maya: kevin/liu/rishi please add implementation tasks to JIRA and link to PRD. reconvene Mon for prioritization.
ops-bot: note: deploy scheduled: feature/transfer-srv -> staging 03:00 UTC, build 102. :shipit:
